title: Evaluation defines the geometric stalk homomorphism on units
statement: Let $K$ be a field, $K^{sep}=\operatorname{SeparableClosure}K$, $\Omega=\operatorname{AlgebraicClosure}K$, $S=\operatorname{Spec}K$ and $p$ its geometric point [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. For the units sheaf [def-sc-gm-torsor], there exists an additive homomorphism $f:(\mathbb G_m)_p\to (K^{sep})^\times$, written additively as in [def-sc-galois-units-cohomology], whose image of each germ, embedded into $\Omega$, equals evaluation of its representing unit at the lift. The exact formula is in the Lean signature. No bijectivity or Galois compatibility is asserted.

proof.text: Use [lem-sc-etale-evaluation-separable] to construct the evaluation ring homomorphism with codomain SeparableClosure K as a subtype of the algebraic closure. The ring-homomorphism laws follow by Subtype.ext from the laws of evaluation. Apply Units.map, Additive.ofMul, and ULift.up to obtain an additive map on units for every pointed neighbourhood.

Restriction of functions commutes with pullback along the lift: the equality is Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop after unfolding pointSmallEtale. Prove equality of unit maps by ULift.ext, Units.ext and Subtype.ext. The compatible family defines a stalk map using Point.presheafFiberDesc; compose with ULift.down to remove the lift. Point.toPresheafFiber_presheafFiberDesc proves the required evaluation formula on every germ.

lean.statement: theorem exists_etale_units_stalk_evaluation (K : Type u) [Field K] : let Ω := AlgebraicClosure K let S := Spec (.of K) let p := pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω))) ∃ f : (p.sheafFiber (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj S.gmSheaf →+ Field.galoisUnitsTopRep K, ∀ (X : S.Etale) (x : p.fiber.obj X) (z : S.gmSheaf.obj.obj (op X)), algebraMap (SeparableClosure K) Ω (Additive.toMul (f (p.toPresheafFiber X x S.gmSheaf.obj z)) : (SeparableClosure K)ˣ) = (ΓSpecIso (.of Ω)).hom (x.left.appTop ((Additive.toMul z.down : Γ(X.left, ⊤)ˣ) : Γ(X.left, ⊤)))
